product_overview: POS Kygoo V2 is a Next.js + TypeScript point-of-sale backend providing authentication, shift management, checkout/transaction processing, inventory control, and admin order operations with role-based guards and audit logging for financial integrity.
core_goals: Ensure secure session management and role-based authorization for all protected operations
Guarantee transactional integrity for POS checkout (order, payments, stock updates, audit logs) with rollback on failure
Provide inventory CRUD and stock adjustment operations with validation and role enforcement
Support shift lifecycle controls preventing invalid operations (duplicate open, close without open)
Expose admin-only operations (void/delete orders) protected by strict role checks
Deliver testable endpoints and flows for blackbox and whitebox validation (including branch/error paths) with traceable audit logs

features.name: Authentication and Session Guard
features.description: Authenticate users, create sessions, and guard protected routes with role checks (redirect or error on missing/invalid session).
user_flows: POST /login with valid admin credentials -> Receive 302 redirect to /dashboard and session cookie -> GET /dashboard with session cookie -> Receive 200 dashboard page
POST /login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Authentication error -> GET /dashboard without session cookie -> Receive 302 redirect to /login

features.name: Shift Operations
features.description: Open (and prevent duplicate open of) shifts required before processing checkout; closing shift must be validated against open state.
user_flows: POST /login with cashier credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /shift/open with session cookie -> Receive 200 Shift opened
POST /login with cashier credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /shift/open with session cookie when a shift is already open -> Receive 400 Shift already open

features.name: Inventory Management API
features.description: Create, list, and adjust products and stock with validation and authorization checks; supports add-product, adjust-stock and product listing.
user_flows: POST /login with admin credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /api/inventory/add-product with body {name, categoryId, price, cost, stock} and session cookie -> Receive 200 Product -> GET /api/inventory/products with session cookie -> Receive 200 Product[]
POST /login with cashier credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /api/inventory/add-product with body {name, categoryId, price, cost, stock} and session cookie -> Receive 403 Unauthorized

POST /login with admin credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /api/inventory/adjust-stock with body {productId, change:0, type:'OUT', note} and session cookie -> Receive 400 Validation error (invalid change value)

POST /login with admin credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /api/inventory/adjust-stock with body {productId, change:-5, type:'OUT', note} and session cookie -> Receive 200 Stock adjustment result

features.name: POS Checkout Transaction
features.description: Process checkout creating order, payments, updating stock and writing audit logs; requires an open shift and validates payment totals and discounts.
user_flows: POST /login with cashier credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /shift/open with session cookie -> Receive 200 Shift opened -> POST /pos/checkout with session cookie and body {items:[{productId,qty,price}], paymentMethods:[{type,amount}], discountType, discountValue} where paymentMethods total equals order total -> Receive 200 Transaction success -> GET /api/inventory/products with session cookie -> Receive 200 Product[] reflecting updated stock

POST /login with cashier credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /pos/checkout with session cookie and body {items:[...], paymentMethods:[...]} when no shift is open -> Receive 400 Business validation error (shift not open)

POST /login with cashier credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /pos/checkout with session cookie and body where split payment amounts do not sum to order total -> Receive 400 Business validation error (payment mismatch)

features.name: Admin Order Control API
features.description: Admin-only operations to void or delete orders; enforces role checks and returns clear errors for not-found cases.
user_flows: POST /login with admin credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /api/admin/void-order with session cookie and body {orderId, reason} -> Receive 200 Void success
POST /login with admin credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /api/admin/delete-order with session cookie and body {orderId, reason} -> Receive 200 Delete success
POST /login with cashier credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /api/admin/void-order with session cookie and body {orderId, reason} -> Receive 403 Unauthorized
POST /login with admin credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /api/admin/delete-order with session cookie and body {orderId:nonexistent, reason} -> Receive 404 Order not found

features.name: Expenses and Incomes
features.description: Create and manage expense/income records; operations limited to admin roles with validation on amounts and explicit errors for missing records.
user_flows: POST /login with admin credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /api/expenses/add with session cookie and body {amount, category, note} -> Receive 200 Created expense record
POST /login with cashier credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /api/expenses/add with session cookie and body {amount, category, note} -> Receive 403 Unauthorized
POST /login with admin credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /api/expenses/add with session cookie and body {amount:-100, category, note} -> Receive 400 Validation error (invalid amount)

features.name: Reports (Financial Aggregation)
features.description: Generate financial reports with grouping (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly) and date-range parameters; must validate date ranges and return aggregates consistent with transactions.
user_flows: POST /login with admin credentials -> Receive session cookie -> GET /api/reports/financial?period=monthly&from=2026-03-01&to=2026-03-31 with session cookie -> Receive 200 Aggregated financial report (totals match underlying transactions)
POST /login with admin credentials -> Receive session cookie -> GET /api/reports/financial?from=2026-04-10&to=2026-03-01 with session cookie -> Receive 400 Date range invalid
GET /api/reports/financial?period=daily&from=2026-03-01&to=2026-03-01 without session cookie -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
